articles.title: Everything From The State Of Play That You Can Try Right Now
articles.summary: The most exciting part of a video game showcase is when developers shadow-drop something immediately after announcing it. Today's State of Play had a few such announcements.
body: Keeper was released by Double Fine in October 2025 and is the latest title from Headlander and Stacking designer Lee Petty. It's a surreal, visually stunning game where you explore a decrepit world as a lighthouse and its fantastical bird companion. It flew under the radar last year, so it's great to see it come to PS5 now that Double Fine is independent once again. It got a price drop and new psychedelic mode today too.

Stupid Never Dies is a quirky new action game from Hiroyuki Kobayashi, a producer best known for his work on series like Dino Crisis and Dragon's Dogma at Capcom. You can get a taste of its flashy action from this new demo, which lasts two hours and lets you transfer progress once Stupid Never Dies launches on October 21.

SlashZero is a fast-paced action roguelike with an anime aesthetic where players control a time hacker trying to kill something called "Hieros-I." While the game won't be out until sometime next spring, a limited-time demo was released on PS5 today.
points: The most exciting part of a video game showcase is when developers shadow-drop something immediately after announcing it.
Today's State of Play had a few such announcements.

articles.title: Sony And Microsoft: We’re Keeping Tariff Refunds For Ourselves And You’ll Get Nothing
articles.summary: Following Nintendo, both Sony and Microsoft have now argued in court that they are not obligated to provide refunds to consumers who paid more for a price-hiked PlayStation or Xbox console related to US President Donald Trump's controversial tariff plan.
body: In July, Sony said it was projecting to get $508 million back in refunds from the US government over the tariffs, and "most" of that money was owed to Sony's gaming division. Sony is facing a lawsuit that claims Sony should disperse refunds, at least in part, to consumers who paid more for a PS5.
Sony's legal team, however, says Sony will keep all the money and you'll get nothing back.

"Paying fair market price for voluntarily purchased consumer goods is not a legally cognizable injury in fact," the lawyers said in a memo seeking to dismiss the class-action suit, as reported by Game File.
Microsoft's own legal team took a similar approach, saying in court, "There is nothing unjust about plaintiff purchasing an Xbox at an advertised price and getting exactly what [they] paid for..."

articles.title: Final Fantasy Resonance: The Final Preview
articles.summary: Final Fantasy Resonance feels like it’s walking a tightrope between being a loving tribute to Final Fantasies past while also taking the series into a cool new direction and telling its own story. Is it going to pull it off?
body: Based on my time with it, Resonance has a lot of cool little moments like that. Let’s get the obvious stuff out of the way. Resonance has the most impressive use of HD-2D I think I’ve ever seen. It’s absolutely gorgeous, and you can see it from the overworld. It’s the way the clouds pass gently overhead, the way the wind seems to rustle the grass beneath your feet. What’s equally stunning is the way your character’s spite moves through all of this. HD-2D is gorgeous, but it can sometimes look like your character is a little out of place in the world. Not so here. Your character looks distinct, but it always seems like they fit.
points: Final Fantasy Resonance feels like it’s walking a tightrope between being a loving tribute to Final Fantasies past while also taking the series into a cool new direction and telling its own story.

articles.summary: With the release date of Final Fantasy VII Revelation confirmed as April 8 during today's PlayStation State of Play, it seems Steam is jumping the gun on what comes after, as two downloadable story expansions have appeared on the digital storefront.
body: Each expansion features specific characters, with the first called "Sephiroth" and the second called "Vincent and the Turks." Both are listed as release "between Winter 2027 and April 2028. No other information is included with the listings.

The news comes alongside an extended look at Final Fantasy VII Revelation during the State of Play, with nearly ten minutes of gameplay exploring the open world, side missions in Yutai and Gongaga, side activities like Queen's Blood, and more.
Series producer Naoki Hamaguchi introduced the gameplay demo, as well as a new Trilogy Edition which combines all three parts of the Final Fantasy VII Remake trilogy into one package.

articles.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Is Getting a Pair of Limited Edition PS5 Controllers
articles.summary: Rockstar Games and PlayStation have revealed a pair of GTA 6-themed PS5 controllers. During the PlayStation State of Play, we got some unexpected GTA 6 news. PlayStation and Rockstar Games' marketing deal will give birth to two limited edition GTA 6 controllers.
body: Pre-orders will open for the controllers through PlayStation Direct on September 10, but fans won't be able to get their hands on them until the game's release on November 19. The controllers will set fans back a whopping $84.99 and you should probably anticipate them selling out quickly given the rabid demand for the game.

The news comes as GTA 6's marketing begins to really ramp up. Last week, Rockstar debuted the first gameplay for GTA 6 and invited select media (including IGN) to participate in previews for the game. Fans have been suffering for years due to Rockstar's extended gaps of silence, but all of that appears to be coming to an end as GTA 6 has locked in its November release date.

articles.summary: Epic Games has announced that it's going to make it easier than ever to hang out and talk with friends across different platforms by launching Epic Parties. This voice chat service will work across Fortnite (on all supported platforms), the Epic Games Store launcher (PC, iOS, and Android), and the…
body: For example, you can start a voice party from your phone or PC launcher, ring up a friend who is busy playing Fortnite on their PlayStation, and even transfer that call from your phone to your PC when you get back to your desk. This means that you can sit in on a voice call through the Epic PC Launcher while playing completely different games from your Epic library. Other benefits include a seamless approach to grouping friends together, as Epic says that if you're in a voice party with friends and everyone decides to open Fortnite, then the game will automatically drop you all into the same lobby together.

articles.title: Final Fantasy 7: Revelation Release Date Confirmed
articles.summary: Square Enix has announced a release date for Final Fantasy 7: Revelation, concluding its acclaimed remake trilogy. The third and final chapter in its Final Fantasy 7 remake saga will arrive on April 8, 2027, it was confirmed today.
body: Following that, two expansions will also be released over the following 12 months. Story DLC 1: Sephiroth and Story DLC 2: Vincent & the Turks are mentioned as part of a Story Expansion pass that's now visible on Steam. No pricing is available yet for this pass, and no further detail on the story content of these DLCs is mentioned, though this confirms that suggested further chapters are on the way — something fans have expected since the pass previously leaked via the Epic Games Store.

All of the game's cast — Cid, Yuffie, Red XIII, Vincent, Barret, Tifa, Cait Sith, and Cloud — made an appearance, with further battle customization detailed. Sidequests will also now play out different depending who you're controlling and, somewhat weirdly, you can skip through dialogue at double speed, making characters sound a bit like chipmunks.

You'll even be able to leap down from the Highwind into the new region of Wutai, parachuting down to ground level like in Fortnite. Once there — and best of all — you'll be able to wile away hours photographing its cats. Speaking of, Red XIII is now the focus of Revelation's compulsive Queen's Blood card game, if you're into that.

The third and final chapter in its Final Fantasy 7 remake saga will arrive on April 8, 2027, it was confirmed today.

articles.title: Until Dawn 2 Reveals Release Date in New Trailer
articles.summary: Until Dawn 2 will release on PS5 this January, as confirmed by a new trailer for the game. During today's PlayStation State of Play, Firesprite showed off a new look at Until Dawn 2.
body: Until Dawn 2 will release on January 28, 2027 with pre-orders opening on September 10. Pre-orders will get access to an "Until Dawn classic" outfit, Akishima Island holiday outfit, and collectible Dr. Hill bobble heads to find throughout the game. There will also be a deluxe edition, which adds Y2K-inspired outfits for all characters and a Diaramoa of Death which lets players "relive every grisly demise with vignettes exploring unique angles of each fatal outcome."

PlayStation's 2027 line up is already looking pretty strong, as Until Dawn 2 will release in January and less than a month later, God of War Laufey will make its debut on PS5. There is also a flurry of speculation and rumors that Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet will release in the second half of 2027, which could make it one of PS5's best years to date. We'll just have to wait and see what happens, but next year is going to be an exciting time for gamers.
Today's announcement comes as part of the latest showcase from PlayStation. Catch up on everything announced during Sony's State of Play September 2026 broadcast right here.

articles.title: Sony's State of Play Officially Confirms Until Dawn 2 Arrives in January
articles.summary: The wait for the sequel to 2015's cult horror game Until Dawn is finally almost over. Sony announced during today's State of Play showcase that Until Dawn 2 will be released on Jan. 28, 2027 and offered a grisly (but campy fun) new look at the choose-your-own-misadventure horror game.
body: The announcement was accompanied by a new trailer for the game that highlighted the series' signature choice-based scares. A highlight of the trailer shows Mina (Camilla Senna) making the choice between "Sacrifice rooster" and "Slash palm." This alone makes Until Dawn 2 a must-play in 2027; what other game gives you the option of "Sacrifice rooster"? We see another cast member choose to cross a rickety rope bridge and meet a grisly fate when it collapses.

Until Dawn 2 follows the cast of Dead True, a ghost hunting YouTube show, as their search for fame and virality. While the show's scares are staged, a new adventure brings them face to face with real horrors as they struggle to survive on a remote island. The star-studded cast includes Dacre Montgomery ( Stranger Things, Power Rangers ), Neil Newbon ( Baldur's Gate 3 's Astarion ), and more.

articles.title: Final Fantasy Resonance is somehow even better than all those beautiful trailers make it look
articles.summary: Let me paint you a picture. It's the second day of Gamescom 2026, everyone is hot and sweaty, the schedule is rapidly deteriorating as previews run late, interviewees go over their allotted times, and dashing from booth to booth adds minutes onto every single journey.
body: No skin off my nose; I'm going to play Resonance on Switch 2 at home anyway. This is the best kind-of preview. Thing is, I'm crammed into a room with eight PS5 units chugging away, 10 sweaty bodies all sitting and standing in close proximity to each other, and my massive backpack slung over my shoulder as I hoist the Switch 2 as close to my face as possible to see what's going on in the middle of all the washed-out overhead lights.

Yet, in the middle of all these adverse conditions, I completely lost myself in the world of Final Fantasy Resonance. It's absolutely spectacular. Even squinting to make out the game, chirping its merry sounds to me through a set of fairly cheap headphones, I could just taste the production values of this unexpectedly lush game. The battle system is deep, rewarding, and hard, the visuals are absolutely gorgeous, and the cameo 'summons' of Final Fantasy characters past and present are so 'hype' that I didn't skip a single animation. I can't wait to get this full game in my hands.

articles.title: Until Dawn 2's sun-kissed horror gets a PS5 release date - and the studio behind last year's brilliant Dispatch is involved
articles.summary: Following its big Summer Game Fest unveiling earlier this year, Until Dawn 2 has been given a release date as part of Sony's latest State of Play showcase. And it's not far away at all, launching for PS5 in the suitably dark depths of winter: arriving 28th January next year.
body: As we learned previously, some big changes are afoot in Until Dawn 2. For starters, the snow-covered alpine resort setting of the first game is making way for sun-kissed tropical climes, where a successful crew of TV ghosthunters (the Dead True) is about to embark on its latest assignment.

"After an investigation at Blackwood Sanitorium takes a chilling turn," Sony explains in its release date announcement, "an encounter with supernatural survivor Yoona leads them to Akishima Island, a remote paradise abandoned for decades and hiding secrets far older than any of them imagined."

New characters does, of course, mean a new cast - but, notably, one familiar face is returning: Peter Stormare, who played Until Dawn 1's memorably unhinged psychiatrist Dr. Hill, is back and will presumably be fulfilling a similar role. Quite how that'll work in story terms, however - given some of the things we learn in the original game - Sony hasn't yet said.

articles.title: Crimson Desert's first DLC is called Charting the Unknown, and it's out next month
articles.summary: It didn't take long for Crimson Desert to get new stuff. During today's State of Play, developer Pearl Abyss unveiled Charting the Unknown. This is the game's first post-launch DLC, and it's set to arrive 15th October.
body: Charting the Unknown brings a new set of story missions to Crimson Desert. Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane set on an adventure that takes the trio deeper into the continent of Pywel. We've known since June that Crimson Desert would get DLC at some point, so it's nice to see it revealed today and that it's not too far off.
Today's trailer also offers a first look at the homesteading and home-building features, and what looks to be a marriage proposal and romance feature.

Charting the Unknown is available to pre-order now, with the Charter's and Charter's Light Diving sets as your pre-order bonus. The DLC announcement comes hot on the heels of Crimson Desert's Enhanced free upgrade. Enhanced bundles all previously-released patches, alongside some new skills, story enhancements, localisations in multiple new languages, a revamp to the way characters earn and quip skills and more.

Not shown today, for obvious reasons, is Crimson Desert's in-development Switch 2 version, which the developer announced in August. Pearl Abyss also said at the time it's exploring multiplayer and live service models for the franchise.

videos.summary: To celebrate the original 1994 PlayStation, LEGO is building something special. With two hidden dioramas, including one of Ape Escape and one of Gran Turismo, the LEGO PlayStation set will be available on Oct. 1 for LEGO Insiders Early Access and everyone on Oct. 4 for $179.99.
